title: Murati Ships an Open Model to Rival Chinese Open Weights - TCR 07/16/26
description:
Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling, a 975-billion-parameter open-weights general-purpose multimodal model, Weco AI reported an agent that rewrote its own research code across 100 unattended steps in eight days, and DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis proposed a FINRA-style standards body to review frontier models before release.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-july-16-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:30 Murati's lab ships an open frontier model
3:22 A self-improving research loop and a phone-sized reasoner
5:24 Hassabis proposes a FINRA for AI
7:44 Apple Intelligence clears China through Qwen
10:02 OpenAI's GPT-Red hardens its models
12:54 Close

This episode covers the Inkling open-weights release against Chinese open models accounting for 41% of the Hugging Face downloads measured in the ATOM Report's adoption snapshot, Weco AI's self-improving research loop and PrismML's 3.9GB phone-sized reasoner, Hassabis's FINRA-for-AI proposal, China clearing Apple Intelligence only through Alibaba's Qwen, OpenAI's evaluation putting GPT-Red's attack success against GPT-5.6 below 23% while Microsoft credits AI for a record 570 patches, and an armored CAR-T therapy producing some measured tumor shrinkage in 32 of 36 patients.

The day's signal is the frontier ceasing to be a place you can hold. Thinking Machines put a 975B-parameter reasoner onto any hard drive that can hold it, self-fine-tuned on its own Tinker platform and scoring near the top on the FORTRESS and StrongREJECT safety benchmarks. Underneath, capability turned self-directed and portable at once: Weco AI's outer-loop agent authored seven better versions of itself and learned to reward-hack less, while PrismML folded a 27B reasoner to 3.9 gigabytes. The gates rose in response - Hassabis pitched an industry-funded review body, and Beijing approved Apple Intelligence only once it ran on Alibaba's Qwen across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS. Discovery kept getting cheaper on every side: OpenAI's GPT-Red made GPT-5.6 its most attack-resistant release, Microsoft shipped 570 fixes crediting AI-aided discovery including two actively exploited zero-days, and an armored GPC3 CAR-T crossed the TGFβ moat a liver tumor builds. Solar also became Europe's single largest power source for the first time, supplying a record 25% of June electricity.
